## 1.3.12 — 2026-09-15

### Descriptions that see, previews that build, a chat that says when it is full, and motion that knows shake from movement

- **Rich descriptions have a quality floor.** Rich never runs below 4
  frames at 448 px; below that the lane holds the clips and names what is
  using the memory. The 2B model is retired (the 4B is the smallest), a
  "too slow" verdict measured under memory pressure is not remembered, and
  the prompt no longer carries an example a blind model could recite.
  Upgrade descriptions gains **Redo all descriptions** for clips that were
  described badly.
- **Memory sizing adds the children together.** On a Mac the 8B model
  needs 48 GB; the text model's budget subtracts the describe and Whisper
  children; a swapping machine steps the Rich model down one size.
- **Previews build for every clip in a project.** A clip outside a Footage
  folder is no longer refused as "already done"; the Catalog page, the
  drop button and the lane share one idea of where a sheet lives.
- **Analysis frames can be cleared.** Per drive from the reset window,
  with the size it frees shown, or automatically after 30 unused days
  (Settings → Analysis → Previews, off by default). Previews and scrub
  survive; a later pass re-extracts what it needs.
- **The timeline is fast again.** It no longer re-lists every drive for
  every clip it paints.
- **The local chat gets a real window.** A model that spills into system
  RAM gets 128k tokens; nothing is sent that the window cannot hold, the
  answer keeps real room, and the panel says when a chat is full. The
  "leave free for Resolve" reserve applies only while Resolve is open.
- **The backup queue remembers.** Copies still owed when the app quits
  resume on the next launch; the Backup chip says how many files are not
  yet backed up.
- **Spellings to fix.** A per-project table of Wrong → Right corrections
  for transcripts, with one press to fix the transcripts you already have.
- **People say how sure they are.** Each person carries a match confidence
  and a "may be two people" flag when the index saw them twice in one
  frame.
- **Motion measures shake apart from movement,** and reads Sony lens
  focal length per frame: a smooth move or a zoom is steady, a hand grab
  is shaky, and shake is reported in image space. Hue steps within
  log-footage noise no longer chop clean ranges, and a one-seventh-of-a-
  stop drift is no longer an exposure ramp. Existing clips pick this up
  the next time motion runs on them.
- **MCP.** Long answers come in pages, `fields` narrows rows, transcripts
  take a time range, timelines warn about near-duplicates and list V2
  coverage gaps, and `export_timeline_transcript` writes the selects with
  both timecodes.
- **Updates and diagnostics.** A failed silent update reopens the
  installer so you can see why; bundles carry free disk space and the
  installer logs.
- **Under the hood.** Six dead AI stages removed, the per-clip reconcile
  pass runs, Social Distribute opens from all three doors, the People tool
  can list only the open project's people.
